add_step_closure: add a step closure to run after the barrier when live tensors are materialized to device data
run_step_closures: run all queued step closures synchronously and asynchronously at the end of a training step
create_ClosureHandler: create a ClosureHandler that runs a list of closure functions sequentially in the training loop
create_AsyncClosureHandler: create an AsyncClosureHandler with a configurable queue size to run closures asynchronously in a background thread
run_ClosureHandler_run: run a single closure function using ClosureHandler.run to execute it immediately
